hook: A 1.5-mm metasurface waveguide gives AR glasses a 30° field of view and a bright image outdoors
hook_turn: gives AR glasses a 30° field of view and a bright image outdoors
summary: Interwoven metasurfaces in two layers steer light in several directions, easing the usual trade-off among field of view, brightness, and eyebox. The prototype reaches a 30° field of view and an 8 by 8 mm eyebox. It is a single prototype, and the field of view is still modest.
title: Metasurface waveguides for all-day augmented reality glasses.
